$comment: The /v1 contract (L3 plan §7.1), checked by every build (scripts/build/contract.ts). Entries are add-only. Any edit to an entry fails the build (needs /v2) until the owner reviews it; a reviewed wording fix sets the new sha, with a Decisions line.

id.means: critwire's integer id for the animal; never changes and is never reused, even after the record is retired

slug.means: short lowercase name for web addresses, letters and digits joined by single hyphens; unique; never reused

scientificName.means: the animal's scientific (Latin) name, genus first, as critwire's registry holds it

taxonomy.means: the animal's class, order, family and genus; from the Catalogue of Life when its match is settled, else critwire's registry (sources[] says which)

taxonomy.class.means: the taxonomic class, scientific name (Mammalia, Reptilia)

ids.means: the animal's ids in outside databases, for joining; each null while its match is unsettled

ids.iucn.means: IUCN Red List species (SIS taxon) id; the id only, no Red List data; null while unsettled

ids.gbif.means: GBIF Backbone Taxonomy usage key (checklist d7dddbf4-2cf0-4f39-9b2a-bb099caae36c); null while the match is unsettled

ids.col.means: Catalogue of Life stable taxon id; null while the match is unsettled

ids.wikidata.means: Wikidata item id (Q followed by digits); null while unsettled

ids.inaturalist.means: iNaturalist taxon id, as Wikidata states it; null while unsettled

ids.ncbi.means: NCBI Taxonomy id, as Wikidata states it; null while unsettled

range.means: where the animal has open records; not its native range

range.countriesWithOpenRecords.means: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes, sorted, of countries with CC0/CC BY GBIF records after critwire's filters (present, coordinates without geospatial issues, no zoo or fossil specimens, lone strays outside the main region withheld until reviewed); not native range; never []; null unless range.status is ok

range.status.means: why range.countriesWithOpenRecords is or isn't set: ok (at least one country), no-open-records (GBIF match settled, no country left after the filters), identity-unsettled (GBIF match unsettled, nothing counted)

photo.means: one Wikimedia Commons photo of the animal, or null; show its credit and license with it

photo.credit.means: who took or owns the photo, as Commons states it

photo.license.means: the photo's license name as Commons states it (CC BY 2.0)

photo.page.means: the photo's Wikimedia Commons file page

sources.means: where each third-party value came from: one entry per source, each naming the fields it filled; JSON and Parquet only

sources[].fields.means: the dotted paths of the fields this source filled (a group path covers its members)

sources[].license.means: the license of the values taken from this source

sources[].retrieved.means: the UTC date critwire fetched it, YYYY-MM-DD; absent for critwire's own registry

sources[].url.means: the exact address critwire read, so the answer can be checked

sources[].doi.means: a DOI to cite the source by (bare, without https://doi.org/)

sources[].release.means: for the Catalogue of Life: the release critwire used; absent otherwise

sources[].release.version.means: the release's version string, as ChecklistBank states it

sources[].checklistKey.means: for GBIF ids: the GBIF checklist the id belongs to; absent otherwise

replacedBy.means: null unless critwire retired this record; then the critwire ids that replace it

code.means: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, plus XK (Kosovo, as GBIF uses it); one row per code; covers every code the species files and GBIF use

name.means: the everyday English name, exactly as Natural Earth has it (NAME_EN); unique

continent.means: the continent, exactly as Natural Earth has it (CONTINENT); far islands are Seven seas (open ocean)

region.means: the United Nations region, as Natural Earth has it (REGION_UN)

subregion.means: the United Nations subregion, as Natural Earth has it (SUBREGION)

speciesId.means: the animal's id in /v1/species (its id field)

country.means: the country the source lists the animal in: a code from /v1/countries; a row says what a source lists, not that the animal lives there; no row means critwire holds no open listing, never that the animal isn't there

area.means: the narrower scope the source states inside the country (Hawaii, Azores), set per source or place, never from free text; null: none recorded, which doesn't claim the whole country

origin.means: how the source says the animal came to be there: native-or-pre-1500 (native, or introduced before 1500 CE; the source doesn't separate the two), native (the source says native, without that blur), introduced (the source says introduced, or lists it on a register of non-native species; doesn't say it lives wild there), uncertain (the source marks its origin uncertain)

presence.means: what the source says about the animal being there: present (the source says present; a native list's present can include a reintroduction into the native distribution), uncertain (the source marks it doubtful, uncertainly present or possibly extinct), absent (the source says absent; doesn't say it once lived there, or why, or since when), unstated (the source gives no status; doesn't say it lives there now)

source.means: the source's name, as attribution.json credits it

sourceKey.means: the source's stable id: a GBIF dataset key, or a short name for any other source (mdd, curated); a GBIF key joins attribution.json's gbifChecklists[].key

license.means: the license of this row's values, as its source grants it

doi.means: a DOI to cite the source by (bare, without https://doi.org/); null only on a curated row, whose url is its reference

url.means: the page to check this row against: the source's page for the taxon, or a curated row's own reference

sourceTerm.means: what the source said: on a source's row verbatim, a place as listed, with its question mark if it has one (Cambodia?), or establishment means and status joined by a slash (INTRODUCED/PRESENT; - when blank); on a curated row, our paraphrase of its reference, in our own words
